column6: old text: Explainer and Q2 say AF2 accuracy degrades for de novo designed proteins; AF2 predicts most designed proteins well. Core Idea dates AlphaFold to 2020 (AlphaFold2; AlphaFold1 was 2018).
old text: Explainer says R-free should decrease monotonically; overstated.

230-space-group bullet listed only mirrors, glides and inversion centers as excluded; groups with only a rotoinversion (e.g. P-4, I-4) are also excluded, so that list does not leave 65. Added rotoinversion and phrased as any handedness-inverting operation.
old text: Explainer describes the proteasome as two stacked rings of 7; the 20S core is four stacked heptameric rings (a7b7b7a7, D7 symmetry).
old text: Core Idea says simulations routinely reach milliseconds; ms is reached only on special hardware (Anton), not routinely.

New ensemble-spread bullet is correct but old Q2 explanation and Explainer say high-RMSD regions are genuinely flexible / ensemble spread is a direct readout of flexibility; old text overstates and now contradicts the new bullet. Not edited (out of scope).

RNA-diagram bullet said the diagram lists base pairs only and listed pseudoknots as a non-base-pair tertiary contact, while the new How section has learners find pseudoknots on that diagram. Swapped pseudoknots for tetraloop-receptor docking. old text: Q1 explanation says A-form RNA has a wider major groove; it is narrow and deep.
